env GOPROXY=off

env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=
go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo,nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo,logosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=none,logosfastcgo

exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo,none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=

go build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-on$'

go env -w GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

go env -w GOEXPERIMENT=none
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

go env -u GOEXPERIMENT

env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^sum42 mode=fastcgo-off$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcgotest

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
#cgo noescape add
#cgo nocallback add
int add(int a, int b) {
	return a + b;
}
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() {
	sum := int(C.add(C.int(40), C.int(2)))
	fmt.Printf("sum%d mode=%s\n", sum, mode)
}

-- mode_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosfastcgo

package main

const mode = "fastcgo-off"

-- mode_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.logosfastcgo

package main

const mode = "fastcgo-on"
